text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty -> inference-gateway service: HIGH 5xx rate spike detected. summary: 5xx rate jumped from 0.3% -> 6.8% in the last 60s. link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

pagerduty: Pager INC12345 triggered (severity: high). Escalation: alice (oncall) -> ben (sre).

alice (oncall): acked. I'm looking. Any immediate mitigations we should flip?

ben (sre): saw the alert. I'm pulling metrics on p50/p95 latency and per-region error rate. Initial hypothesis: short-lived surge concentrated on requests with seq_len > 1024 hitting a quantized model variant.

carmen (prodops): customers? any broad user impact reported yet?

alice (oncall): internal dashboards show errors mostly from eu-west1 and us-east1 edges. 502/504 dominant. No customer tickets yet but spike aligns with a small increase in long-context demo traffic.

ben (sre): running quick grep on logs, getting repeated upstream resets to model-host: kv-proxy timeout 120s. snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T22:12:03Z] INFO gateway request id=abcd1234 route=/v1/generate status=502 upstream_err="read: connection reset by peer" seq_len=1536 model=redwood-7b-q4
[2026-03-17T22:12:04Z] WARN kv-proxy pool=eu-west1 conn=235 timeout=120s
```

alice (oncall): ok -- mitigation plan: 1) throttle/route long-seq requests to a fallback model variant with lower memory footprint, 2) temporarily increase kv-proxy pool in eu-west1, 3) suppress noisy PD pages (signal smoothing) for 5m to avoid duplicate wakeups. I'll start 1 and 3.

carmen (prodops): please note customer-facing comms if this persists > 30m. Also flag customers using long-context tier.

ben (sre): Infrastructure change: bumped kv-proxy replica count in eu-west1 and issued a rolling restart of the heavy model canary in us-east1. Also enabled prefix KV cache warmup for the affected model pool.

alice (oncall): routed long-seq traffic to redwood-7b-compat-lt (fallback) via routing override:
```
POST /admin/route-override
{
  "selector": "seq_len > 1024",
  "target": "redwood-7b-compat-lt",
  "duration": "10m"
}
```

pagerduty: note: alert suppressed for INC12345 for 300s by alice.

ben (sre): after changes, 5xx rate dropped to 0.7% in 90s. p95 latency back to baseline. Looks like a bell-curve spike — concentrated on long sequences. No DB or auth faults.

alice (oncall): good signal. keeping monitoring on for 15m. Carmen, can you watch for customer tickets and escalate comms if we cross 10m sustained impact window?

carmen (prodops): on it. Slack watch + inbox monitor.

alice (oncall): follow-up actions: open incident tracker, tag with root cause candidate: "kv-proxy timeout under long-seq load + canary memory GC pressure". Plan a postmortem with model-onboarding/serving teams. I'm re-enabling PD alerts after 10m.

ben (sre): creating infra PR to add autoscaling cushion for kv-proxy pools on seq_len distribution spikes. Also recommend adding a soft quota for seq_len per API key to reduce blast radius.

alice (oncall): INC12345 resolved? I'll close once we hit 30m stable and no customer impact.

pagerduty: INC12345 acknowledged by alice at 1755554330. incident status: under investigation.

incident-bot: check-in at +5m -> 5xx rate 1.1% (improving). +10m -> 0.6%. No new alerts.

carmen (prodops): no customer tickets in 12m. monitoring will run 24/7 for next 48h with alert threshold reduced for seq_len anomalies.

alice (oncall): thanks team. marking handoff: leaving oncall to ben in 20m if stable. final note: suppressed PD pages prevented noisy wakeups during mitigation; we should review suppression policy in follow-up.

ben (sre): I'll take the handoff and keep watch. :thumbsup:

alice (oncall): handing off to ben at 1755554600. closing thread for now, will append incident link when tracker created.

incident-bot: thread closed (temporary) — please create formal incident doc: INCIDENT-2026-03-17-5xx-bellcurve.
